title: SpreadsheetBench Real-World Tabular Manipulation Benchmark and Evaluation

nodes.label:
Four Excel Forum Communities Sourcing
Harvests Real Posts from ExcelForum, Chandoo, MrExcel & ExcelGuru
Collects Real-World User Challenges in Tabular Data Processing

Solved Q&A Thread Filtering
Filters Threads Marked Explicitly as Solved by Community Users
Extracts Verified Working Solutions, Formulas & Macro Scripts

Task Question Normalization & Filtering
Filters Out Vague Requests, Corrupt Files or Non-Standard Layouts
Retains Complex Multi-Step Spreadsheet Manipulation Challenges

GPT-4 Instruction Rewriting
Rewrites Informal Forum Posts into Clear Technical Task Prompts
Specifies Exact Input Sheet Ranges, Constraints & Expected Outputs

Human Cell Coordinate & Grounding Verification
Domain Experts Verify Sheet Coordinates, Data Formats & Header Logic
Confirms Task Completeness against Attached Excel Files

Deterministic Ground Truth Solution Derivation
Executes Community Formulas & Scripts to Produce Ideal Output Sheets
Validates Mathematical Precision of Target Cell Values

Original Test Case Packaging
Packages Initial Spreadsheet Workbooks into Standardized Test 1
Embeds Input Sheets, Solution References & Execution Masks

Dual-Round Data Modification & Value Perturbation
Perturbs Numerical Values, Replaces Entities & Shifts Table Rows
Synthesizes Novel Problem Instances Retaining Identical Logic

Two Supplementary Test Cases Generation
Constructs Test Case 2 & Test Case 3 with Perturbed Spreadsheets
Forms Multi-Test Suite to Detect Hardcoded Overfitting

Anti-Leakage Structural Edits
Applies Header Renaming, Column Swapping & Formula Aliasing
Ensures No Raw Memorization from Pretraining Web Crawls

Two-Stage Human Quality Control
Senior Data Engineers Execute End-to-End Workbook Validations
Verifies Automated Grading Scripts across All 3 Test Instances

SpreadsheetBench Frozen Suite (912 Tasks / 2,729 Tests)
Freezes 912 Diverse Real-World Spreadsheet Problems
Supplied with 2,729 Rigorously Verified Test Workbooks

Multi-Modal Workbook Prompting & Code Generation
Inputs Spreadsheet Structure & Query; Prompts Python/VBA Code
Zero-Shot Protocol Demanding Executable Manipulation Scripts

Automated Multi-Test Execution Sandbox
Executes Model-Generated Code in Secure Containerized Environment
Applies Changes Across Original Test 1 and Perturbed Tests 2 & 3

Exact-Match Cell Matrix Verification
Compares Output Cell Values Against Gold Reference Workbooks
Checks Data Types, Numerical Tolerances & String Normalization

Soft & Hard Online Judge (OJ) Reporting
Reports Soft OJ Acc (≥1 Test Pass) and Strict Hard OJ Acc (All 3 Pass)
Provides Authoritative Benchmarking for LLM Spreadsheet Agents
